Alias.name: Fix GUI Events
Alias.script: -- ============================================================================= -- FIX GUI COMMAND -- This command uses the centralized initialization system to refresh all -- GUI components. It's the user-facing command for manual refresh. -- ============================================================================= if GUI and GUI.initializeOrRefresh then GUI.initializeOrRefresh("fix gui command") else cecho("\n<yellow>GUI system not fully loaded. Please close and reopen your profile, then try again.") end

Alias.name: Debug
Alias.script: if matches[2] then demonnic:listCategories() else demonnic:toggleDebug() end

Alias.name: debug categories
Alias.script: if matches[2] then demonnic:watchCategory( matches[2] ) else demonnic:listCategories() end

Alias.name: Toggle blinking (temporary change)
Alias.script: if demonnic.chat.config.blink then demonnic.chat.config.blink = false demonnic.chat.tabsToBlink = {} demonnic:echo("Blinking temporarily turned <red>off<grey>. It will reset if you edit your tabbed chat configuration, or close and reopen mudlet. To make it permanent, change demonnic.chat.config.blink to false in \"Demonnic->Tabbed Chat->Configuration options\" under scripts\n") else demonnic.chat.config.blink = true demonnic.chat:blink() demonnic:echo("Blinking temporarily turned <red>on<grey>. It will reset if you edit your tabbed chat configuration, or close and reopen mudlet. To make it permanent, change demonnic.chat.config.blink to true in \"Demonnic->Tabbed Chat->Configuration options\" under scripts\n") end

Alias.name: dsound
Alias.script:
-- Toggle chat sound notifications if demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = not demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled
if demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled then cecho("
<green>Chat sound notifications ENABLED<reset>
") -- Play a test sound local soundPath = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/LuminariGUI/" .. demonnic.chat.config.soundFile local file = io.open(soundPath, "r") if file then file:close() playSoundFile(soundPath, demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume) else -- Try user's home directory as fallback soundPath = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/" .. demonnic.chat.config.soundFile file = io.open(soundPath, "r") if file then file:close() playSoundFile(soundPath, demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume) else -- Try system beep as final fallback playSoundFile("") -- Empty string triggers system beep in Mudlet end end else cecho("
<red>Chat sound notifications DISABLED<reset>
") end
-- Save to GUI.toggles for persistence if GUI and GUI.toggles then GUI.toggles.chatSound = demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end else cecho("
<red>Chat system not initialized. Type 'fix chat' to reinitialize.<reset>
") end

Alias.name: set chat sound
Alias.script:
local args = matches[2]:split(" ") local command = args[1] local value = args[2]
if command == "on" or command == "off" then -- Enable/disable sounds demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = (command == "on") GUI.toggles.chatSound = demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) cecho(string.format("
<yellow>Chat sounds %s<reset>
", command:upper()))
elseif command == "volume" and value then -- Set volume (0-100) local vol = tonumber(value) if vol and vol >= 0 and vol <= 100 then demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume = vol cecho(string.format("
<yellow>Chat sound volume set to %d<reset>
", vol)) else cecho("
<red>Volume must be between 0 and 100<reset>
") end
elseif command == "file" and value then -- Set sound file demonnic.chat.config.soundFile = value cecho(string.format("
<yellow>Chat sound file set to: %s<reset>
", value))
elseif command == "cooldown" and value then -- Set cooldown between sounds local cd = tonumber(value) if cd and cd >= 0 then demonnic.chat.config.soundCooldown = cd cecho(string.format("
<yellow>Chat sound cooldown set to %d seconds<reset>
", cd)) else cecho("
<red>Cooldown must be 0 or positive number<reset>
") end
elseif command == "test" then -- Test the sound local soundPath = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/LuminariGUI/" .. demonnic.chat.config.soundFile local file = io.open(soundPath, "r") if file then file:close() playSoundFile(soundPath, demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume) cecho("
<green>Playing test sound...<reset>
") else -- Try user's home directory as fallback soundPath = getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\", "/") .. "/" .. demonnic.chat.config.soundFile file = io.open(soundPath, "r") if file then file:close() playSoundFile(soundPath, demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume) cecho("
<green>Playing test sound from user directory...<reset>
") else playSoundFile("") -- Empty string triggers system beep in Mudlet cecho("
<yellow>Sound file not found, playing default beep<reset>
") end end
else -- Show help cecho("
<cyan>Chat Sound Commands:<reset>
") cecho(" <white>set chat sound on/off<reset> - Enable or disable sounds for ALL channels
") cecho(" <white>set chat sound volume <0-100><reset> - Set volume level
") cecho(" <white>set chat sound file <filename><reset> - Set sound file
") cecho(" <white>set chat sound cooldown <seconds><reset> - Set cooldown between sounds
") cecho(" <white>set chat sound test<reset> - Test the current sound
") cecho("
<yellow>Current settings:<reset>
") cecho(string.format(" Enabled: %s (plays for ALL channels)
", demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled and "YES" or "NO")) cecho(string.format(" Volume: %d
", demonnic.chat.config.soundVolume)) cecho(string.format(" File: %s
", demonnic.chat.config.soundFile)) cecho(string.format(" Cooldown: %d seconds
", demonnic.chat.config.soundCooldown)) end

Alias.name: fixChat
Alias.script:
-- ============================================================================= -- FIX CHAT COMMAND -- This command uses the centralized initialization system with focus on chat. -- It ensures the chat system is properly initialized and visible. -- ============================================================================= GUI.initializeOrRefresh("fix chat command")
-- Additional chat-specific actions if GUI.chatContainer then GUI.chatContainer:raise() if demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.container then demonnic.chat:showAllTabs() end end
